messages:
mira: Twilight handoff — quick async standup. Did: finished curation pass on ptset 'retail-longctx' and pushed ~1.2k new prompts. Blocker: saw intermittent BLEU drop on synth eval for spanish slices. Today: re-run eval with kv-warmup tweak and open PR for prompt de-dupe.
dan: Nice. Where are the logs for the BLEU drop? cc @sasha
mira: linked job: eval-batch/retail-longctx/2026-03-17 (see below). Errors look like <1% of samples but clustered at >2048 tokens. Might be kv eviction.
sasha: I'll tail the job. If it's kv eviction, we may need to extend warmup tokens or lower batch size.
eval-bot: eval-batch/retail-longctx/2026-03-17 status: complete. Metrics: BLEU -6.3%, Accuracy -0.8%, avg_latency +12ms. Top failing buckets: spanish-long >2048 tokens.
leo: For a quick mitigation, can we run the same eval pinned to llama3-smallq-quant and compare? quantization might be masking drift.
mira: On it. Running pin: `redwood eval run --job retail-longctx --model llama3-smallq-quant --kv-warmup 1024` — will post results.
dan: Heads-up: CRD #4827 (prompt de-dupe) is ready for review. Tests pass but want a second pair of eyes on the regex. @leo @sasha
sasha: Reviewing now, ETA 30m. If it's safe, we can roll to canary and shadow traffic for 2 hours.
mira: Result: pinned run shows BLEU -0.9% and latency +3ms. Looks like warmup helped. Marking immediate blocker cleared. Will update prompt set to remove ~200 duplicates and open canary config.
leo: Great. After canary, let's snapshot metrics and create postmortem if drift persists. Also flag for Optimize team about batch patterns.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for promptset retail-longctx on dedicated:canary-2 at 1769999050 (react :rocket:).
